comments.body: There was a proposal to add `max_fee` to the tx envelope to replace the other gas fee quantities. It follows the same reasoning as from EIP-7999. I kinda like this move, especially with state and blobs being explicit separate dimensions from normal gas. Curious what others think?

If there is interest I can make a short presentation on the suggestions of [this](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/eip-8141-frame-transaction/27617/172?u=aelowsson) comment (including the unified `max_fee`).

Hey! I won't be able to join the breakout call. I'll leave client and live testnet updates on frames from ethrex side:

**Testnet**
- The frames testnet has been live for 14 days.
- Three client implementations are validating the network now: ethrex, Geth, and Nethermind.
- Almost 400 frame transactions sent, 21 from distinct senders.
- Several community initiatives on making tooling to use in the testnet. I didn't get to gather the sources, but it'd be cool to do it for the next breakout call.

**Client updates**
- The spec didn't change recently, so no new changes were made to `frames-devnet-0`.
- We are still passing all spec tests.
- We are ready for an interop devnet.

**Spec updates/proposals**
- We've made great progress towards writing a spec on how frames and FOCIL should work together. We will have a PR to https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs for the next FOCIL breakout call.
- I proposed adding an endpoint to `execution-apis` based on feedback from testnet users that wanted a way to simulate frame transactions https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/894. We currently implement it under an extension (`ethrex_` namespace), but it'd be a good time to make it standard for all clients.

I won't be able to attend due to timezones, but my main feedback as I am implementing this into Viem:

JSON-RPC on frame txs feels under specified on both the EIP and execution-apis spec. Main friction we are having right now is that tools need:
- a way to estimate gas for frames: `eth_estimateGas` or other
- support for gas estimation/fill in `eth_fillTransaction` 
- support for frame txs in simulation: `eth_simulateV1` or @ilitteri's proposal above
